summary: Iteration 18: Frontend testing of Cosmic Runner 3-lane space game. All 12 features tested and working correctly. Game loads with Bullpug sprite, 3-lane system works with A/D and Arrow keys, jump works with Space/ArrowUp, obstacles appear and cause collision, mooncakes collectible, game over screen with score/retry/share buttons, skin store modal displays properly with all skins and rarity badges, leaderboard shows on right side.
passed_tests: Game loads and displays start screen with Bullpug sprite character
Game canvas is visible and properly sized
START button is visible and clickable
Game starts when clicking START button
3-lane system works - player switches lanes with A/D keys
3-lane system works - player switches lanes with Arrow keys
Jump mechanic works with Space key
Jump mechanic works with ArrowUp key
Obstacles appear (meteors with fire trails visible)
Mooncakes collectibles appear and glow
Collision detection works - hitting obstacles ends the game
Score increases over time during gameplay
Stage progression indicator visible (Stage 1/5)
Game over screen shows correctly with score
Game over screen shows stage reached
Game over screen shows mooncakes collected
Game over screen shows 'NEW HIGH SCORE!' badge when applicable
Retry button works - restarts the game
Share X button visible for Twitter sharing
Skin store button visible and clickable
Skin store modal opens with proper styling
Skin store shows 'Currently Equipped' section
Skin store displays all 12 skins in grid
Skin store shows rarity badges (COMMON, UNCOMMON, RARE, EPIC, LEGENDARY, MYTHIC)
Skin store shows bonus percentages for each skin
Skin store shows prices in SOL
Ethereal achievement skin shows 'ACHIEVEMENT' overlay
Leaderboard displays on the right side
Leaderboard shows player names and scores
Leaderboard shows 'Resets every Monday 00:00 UTC'
Sound toggle button works
Controls hint visible (A/D to switch lanes, SPACE to jump)
Deep space black background with stars visible
3D perspective ground with energy grid visible
Leaderboard API integration works (score submitted, rank displayed)
seed_data_creation: Scores submitted to leaderboard during gameplay tests (Guardian - scores 54, 55)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cosmic Runner game is fully functional with 3-lane Subway Surfers style mechanics. All controls (A/D, Arrow keys, Space) work correctly. Obstacle types include meteors with fire trails (stage 1). Mooncakes are collectible. Game over screen shows score, stage reached, mooncakes collected, retry and share buttons. Skin store has 12 skins with proper rarity badges and pricing. Leaderboard integration works - scores are submitted and rank is displayed.

game_mechanics.scoring: Score increases over time, bonus for mooncakes collected
